extDescription.message: Shows when a page was published and last modified, with where each date came from and how much to trust it.

conflictPredated.message: This page is probably older than it says

conflictStale.message: This page may have changed since it says

conflictDisagreementDetail.message: {1} says {2}, while {3} says {4} for the same field.

conflictPredatedDetail.message: Declares {1}, but carries {2} dated elements from before then, back to {3}. The declared date is likely a republication, not when this was written.

conflictStaleDetail.message: The page declares {1} and shows no update, but the archive records a change on {2}.

emptyNoDate.message: No date found. That is sometimes the correct answer — this page may genuinely not state when it was written.

emptyUnsupported.message: Open a web page to check when it was written.

errorUnreadable.message: Could not read this page. Browser settings pages and extension galleries are off limits to extensions.

archiveCheck.message: Check the archive for hidden edits

archiveNothing.message: The archive records no edits since this was published.

optPrivacyNote.message: This extension asks for nothing at install time. Each setting below that needs wider access requests it when you turn it on, and gives it back when you turn it off.

optAutoReadHelp.message: Shows the age on the toolbar icon without opening this panel. Requires permission to read every site you visit — the browser will ask when you turn this on.

optAutoReadDenied.message: Permission was declined, so this stayed off.

optArchive.message: Check the archive for edits a page does not admit to

optArchiveHelp.message: Finding edits a page hides means asking web.archive.org what it has stored, which tells them the address of the page you are on.

overlayCounterLabel.message: The page says {1}, but the oldest date it carries is from {2}.

optOverlay.message: Show the age in the corner of the page

optOverlayHelp.message: Most pages never print their own date — it sits in metadata you cannot see — so this is usually the only place it appears. Needs automatic checking to be on.

optOverlayNeedsAutoRead.message: Turn on automatic checking above to use this.

menuNoDate.message: No date found for this link.

menuNeedsPermission.message: Permission to read that site was declined.

optSearchAnnotate.message: Show ages next to search results

optSearchAnnotateHelp.message: Adds the age of each result to Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Hacker News and old Reddit, so a page from 2013 is visible before you click it.

optSearchUrl.message: From the link address only — makes no requests

optSearchFetchHelp.message: Reading the results themselves answers for far more of them, and means this extension requesting pages from sites you have not opened. Capped at the first {1} results on a page, and cookies are never sent.

optSearchDenied.message: Permission was declined, so this stayed off.

optSearchPartial.message: Permission to read every site was declined, so only the link address is used.

optLinkMenu.message: Add “When was this page written?” to the right-click menu

optLinkMenuHelp.message: Checks a link without opening it. Asks for access to that one site at the moment you use it, and only if the address alone does not answer.

optCacheHelp.message: Results are kept for a week so re-opening a page is instant. They are stored on this device only, and never sent anywhere.
